concept: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 그 다음 스킬의 최신 버전을 사용하여 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 이번에 반영한 주제가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

prompt_en: A layered photographic study of local color and pattern shows a complex scene in progress in a botanical greenhouse shadecloth workshop. A woman is portrayed using the supplied photograph as the visible appearance reference: her softly rounded oval face, dark brown eyes, short dark chin-length bob and fine loose fringe remain recognizable. This is an invented working moment. She is a scenic fabric maker preparing a repaired shade curtain for a small greenhouse installation. Her quiet half-smile and easy shoulders lend the portrait a gently inviting presence while attention rests on the just-finished work. A washed linen curtain panel hangs from a plain rail beside her, its lower edge ending at her waist. Her left hand steadies the curtain edge; her right palm smooths its front surface beside the newly sewn tab, fingers resting flat on the cloth. Both elbows bend comfortably in the open space before her torso. The curtain carries the color and pattern study on one continuous, visibly woven surface. Pale butter-yellow linen is the broad ground. Fine indigo-blue vertical lines run at close, even intervals, crossed at right angles by much more widely spaced indigo horizontal rulings. The two sets have similarly narrow line widths and form tall rectangular cells. Crossings are clean and readable across the flat central area, while a shallow fold gently bends the same repeat at the edge. Yellow occupies most of the curtain; the blue remains a small-area linear pattern rather than large color blocks. A single solid scarlet-red replacement tab is stitched into the lower near corner of that same curtain, roughly one hundredth of its visible area. Its color ends at the stitched perimeter. The tab has a plain unpatterned face, its fine linen weave and thread holes visible. A short clipped thread and a closed pair of small sewing scissors on the bench below connect her smoothing gesture with the repair just completed. Her faded olive work apron over a sand-colored blouse and the muted wooden bench stay subordinate to the yellow curtain, blue rulings and small red exception. Overcast doorway light spreads a soft neutral illumination across her face and the curtain, preserving yellow, blue, scarlet and natural skin tones as distinct surface colors. A weak greenish fluorescent tube recedes among damp pots and glass framing in the far background; its faint colored reflection stays in that depth. Gentle print-like contrast preserves the curtain's material texture and color boundaries. The capture camera sits at waist height and looks gently upward along the hanging panel in a medium environmental portrait, including her face, both working hands, the entire curtain and the rail. A natural-perspective lens and sufficient depth of field hold the face, crossings and tab clear. The viewer can read a completed repair being checked before the curtain returns to use.
